step0.name: Init Process Principles

principles: 1. LOG FIRST, ACT SECOND - Log every user interaction to log.json BEFORE responding or making changes
2. READ JSON FOR GUIDANCE - Step instructions live in .json files, not .md files
3. STOP AT CHECKPOINTS - When approvalRequired: true, present deliverables, ask for approval, WAIT
4. NO EXTERNAL TODOS - Process steps ARE your task list. Do NOT use todo_write
5. VERIFY MANDATORY ACTIONS - For MANDATORY/CRITICAL instructions: do action, then output confirmation
6. USE SUBAGENTS FOR STEPS - Delegate step execution to step-executor subagent

step0.notes: Principles loaded and confirmed at process start
